title: Enemy Territory HUD aspect correction
status: PARTIAL; the centred uniform 4:3 correction is enabled and observed, and every official map already had an audio zone sidecar; per-element HUD rules are deliberately absent because ET's in-game HUD cannot yet be recorded; the profile stays development-gated
correction: The HUD aspect system is whitelisted by title in two places: the client enablement in CL_HudInit and the root-archive allowlist in FS_RootArchiveAllowsFile. Enemy Territory reached neither, so its 2D draws stretched with the frame on a non-4:3 display even though its own compat layer already routes them through the HUD path. Both predicates now include ET, which gives it the centred uniform 4:3 correction.

audioZones.regenerationNote: Every shipped sidecar was regenerated from the retail installation with the current compiler and compared byte for byte; all six match, so the shipped set is current and the Elite Force profiles added to the compiler did not disturb ET output.

hudRules.reason: ET's client reaches the limbo panel and no further. That panel is one full-screen composition, so pinning its pieces to different edges would pull it apart, and the in-game HUD it would make sense to anchor has never been drawn here. Rules are absent rather than guessed.

hudCapture.method: scripts/probe_wolfet_client.py with cl_hudDump 1, which now preserves the engine's dump alongside its console log and captures.
hudCapture.evidence: The team command was accepted and the server logged "entered the game", but every recorded group is limbo or console art and the capture shows the limbo panel with JOIN A TEAM still offered. Shortening g_redlimbotime and restarting the map did not change the recorded set.

wideAspectObservation.finding: At cl_hudAspect 0 the panel stretches to fill the frame; at 1 it renders centred in 4:3 with pillarbox bars and the composition intact. Both frames show the same mission time, so this pair does isolate the correction, unlike the Elite Force gameplay pair recorded on 2026-09-21.
wideAspectObservation.note: Captures stay under .tmp because they are derived from retail assets.

limits: No per-element HUD anchoring is claimed for ET; only the centred uniform correction is enabled and observed.
The observation is the limbo panel, which is the furthest this engine's ET client reaches; no gameplay HUD, and no gameplay, is claimed.
Audio zones were already complete and are unchanged by this slice; they remain a first pass with no listening check, as recorded on 2026-09-18.
Enemy Territory remains development-gated; release builds still refuse the profile.
